title: Enabling visitors to support your content
summary: Beacons is a free, all-in-one platform with the best link in bio, media kit builder, online store and email marketing tool for creators on Instagram + Tiktok
body_markdown:
Creating content is tough work, which is why we've built the simplest way for fans to support you right from your Beacons page: the **Support Form** . All you need to do is


1.


[Sign in](https://beacons.ai/signin) and go to the Support Form section under the drop-down menu (or click[here](https://beacons.ai/account?defaultTab=donations) )


2.


Connect your Stripe account if you haven't already.[Click here to read over how to setup your Stripe account.](https://blog.beacons.ai/setting-up-with-stripe/)


1.


Customize your form with a description, the item you would like visitors to gift you (coffee's pretty standard), and how much each item costs


To save vertical space, you can also change your Support Form into a Support Button:


When visitors support you, it'll look something like this:


### You keep 100% of the money after credit card fees.


**Tips**


-


Use the description section to talk about what the money's going to, for example some new equipment, a new project, or a fan-inspired challenge


-


You can also embed a[YouTube video](https://blog.beacons.ai/featuring-a-video/) describing what the money is going to, and it'll let you add some more personality to your page 😎


-


Does it seem a bit weird that you need to ask supporters to buy you an item? This is because we had to be extra careful due to strict financial regulations


‍
